authorship: Synthetic. We wrote every answer and every gold label for this eval, before any model call on it. Not from real users; plain text, no speech recognition.

label_definitions.addressed: The answer gives what the objective asks for. As in the product prompt, addressed means the answer responds to the objective, not that it is true or a good outcome; a relevant refusal or a qualified commitment can address it.
label_definitions.partial: The answer gives some of the required content but not all of it, or a less specific version that still narrows it (for example 'next week' for a date, 'the data' for a cause).
label_definitions.not_addressed: The answer gives none of the required content: the point is absent, off-topic, only gestured at with no content ('soon', 'a few things'), negated, or mentioned without being met ('we still need an owner').
label_definitions.unclear: Never a gold label. A model or code-check 'unclear' is scored as wrong against any gold label.

items.request_text: Ask my manager if I can lead the January checkout launch.

objectives.text: State clearly that you want to lead the launch.
Give one concrete reason you are ready.
Name what you would need from your manager.

items.answer: So, um, I wanted to ask if I could lead the checkout launch in January. I ran the payments migration last spring and we shipped it two days early, so I think I know how to keep a release like this on track. Uh, I'd probably need some help from you here and there.

rationale.ask: Asks directly to lead the January checkout launch.
rationale.why: Names the payments migration shipped two days early.
rationale.support: Says help is needed but not what help.

items.request_text: Ask my manager if I can lead the January checkout launch.

items.answer: Yeah so the checkout launch, it's, it's a big one. I've been thinking a lot about it. I really like the work the team's doing and I think it's going to be great for customers. Anyway I'd love to be more involved somehow.

rationale.ask: Wants to be 'more involved somehow', never asks to lead.
rationale.why: Liking the team's work is not a reason they are ready.

items.scenario: explaining a delay to a client

items.scenario: explaining a delay to a client

items.request_text: Answer the interview question: tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate.

items.answer: Sure. On my last team, Kwame and I disagreed about whether to rewrite our billing service or patch it. I asked if we could each write a one-page plan with costs and put them in front of the lead. We ended up going with one of the plans.

rationale.situation: Rewrite versus patch the billing service.
rationale.action: Proposed two one-page plans for the lead.
rationale.result: Says a plan was chosen, not which or what came of it.

items.request_text: Answer the interview question: tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate.
